requirements.statement: Every certification profile is inventory-backed and exactly covered by claims.
requirements.invariant: No owned product capability is absent from the requirement catalog.

requirements.statement: Integration executes both Agent and Business selected test suites.
requirements.invariant: Every selected integration suite produces current JUnit evidence.

requirements.statement: CI certification preserves immutable source claim identity.
requirements.invariant: A repair transition cannot be relabeled as unbound current-pass evidence.

requirements.statement: Repair validates inputs, runs a fixer, targeted verification and the full Judge.
requirements.invariant: No fixer runs before protected-input validation and no targeted run closes a target.

requirements.statement: Every module capability proves its exact owned runtime adapter.
requirements.invariant: Registered capabilities import and execute their owned public route without nearby substitution.

requirements.statement: Protected model smoke validates exact base output and unique goal declarations.
requirements.invariant: Model smoke output crosses production goal validation.

requirements.statement: Exact grounding reads serve downstream actions without capability substitution.
requirements.invariant: A grounding read is not reclassified as the downstream write capability.

requirements.statement: Doctor fails when installed dependencies drift from locks.
requirements.invariant: Both Python environments and frontend dependencies match committed locks.

requirements.statement: Core cannot depend back on Composition Root.
requirements.invariant: The protected package dependency graph has no forbidden reverse edge or SCC.

requirements.statement: Model context preserves complete tool exchanges at every budget boundary.
requirements.invariant: Provider messages contain no orphan or incomplete tool result sequence.

requirements.statement: Valid historical evidence can satisfy a new query goal without satisfying an action.
requirements.invariant: Goal coverage records scope, activity and customer visibility of reused evidence.

requirements.statement: Conversation cases execute their declared actor/thread topology.
requirements.invariant: Thread-local checkpoint, Draft, Workflow and visible evidence never cross topology edges.

requirements.statement: Frontend selection, thread and interaction state follow explicit product transitions.
requirements.invariant: User selection and active thread do not reset from callback identity or unrelated refresh.

requirements.statement: Runtime failures produce stable redacted replay envelopes.
requirements.invariant: Replay contains no raw secret or actor identity and has a deterministic fingerprint.

requirements.statement: High-risk invariants declare executable faulty variants and kill proofs.
requirements.invariant: A Gate cannot be release-authoritative unless its declared mutations are rejected.

requirements.statement: Same-turn result pipelines consume only a prior permit-backed observation output or its verified member while historical references remain release-backed.
requirements.invariant: Ledger presence alone never authorizes a ResultRef and a valid query/member or sort/take/read pipeline is not blocked before final release.

requirements.statement: Capability targets are a runtime-validated discriminated union.
requirements.invariant: A target mode cannot carry fields owned by another mode or an incomplete set operator.

requirements.statement: Planner, verifier and support model calls have isolated bounded capacity in one audit trace.
requirements.invariant: Planner exhaustion cannot consume the capacity required for capability or answer release verification.

requirements.statement: Protected Business queries execute against PostgreSQL through domain filters.
requirements.invariant: Protected business authority never falls back to local SQLite.

requirements.statement: PostgreSQL checkpoint fencing rejects replaced tokens with zero stale writes.
requirements.invariant: Lease validation and mutation are one database transaction.

requirements.statement: Running Agent and Business services pass authenticated HTTP/SSE transaction flows.
requirements.invariant: Public product routes cross the formal lifecycle and transaction authority chain.

requirements.statement: Critical desktop and mobile user journeys pass in a real browser.
requirements.invariant: Selection, thread navigation, pending resume, chat accessibility and mobile reachability are user-operable.

requirements.statement: Protected Agent and Business start under preproduction trust and persistence.
requirements.invariant: Protected execution is fail-closed for verifiers, signatures and PostgreSQL.

requirements.statement: The real model passes goal prototypes and complete lifecycle canaries.
requirements.invariant: Real provider messages remain protocol-valid and the full graph reaches a safe product outcome.

requirements.statement: Immutable source builds and verifies a clean lock-rebuilt artifact.
requirements.invariant: Artifact identity binds source, evidence, file list and hashes.
